item.title: How I Created My Own Admin Account on a Production System
item.description: A severe authorization flaw allowed the creation of a full-privilege admin account on a major Fortune 50 company’s live platform. This resulted in unrestricted access to sensitive financial data, internal files, and the ability to delete users and organizations.
